faq.q: Which AI image generator is best overall in 2026?
faq.a: ChatGPT is the most convenient all-round choice for many users. Midjourney is stronger for art direction, while Firefly is often the better production choice for Adobe teams.

faq.q: What is the best AI image generator for text?
faq.a: Ideogram is the first tool to test for posters, title cards, labels, and other images that require readable text. Still proofread every output.

faq.q: Can I use AI-generated images commercially?
faq.a: Often yes, but the answer depends on the provider, plan, input assets, and jurisdiction. Read the current terms and keep human review in the workflow.

faq.q: Is Midjourney better than ChatGPT for images?
faq.a: Midjourney generally offers a stronger signature art style. ChatGPT is easier for iterative edits and mixed instructions. The better choice depends on the deliverable.
